message:
Yes—Plan B gives you later morning starts. Its studio meets Tuesday/Thursday 10–11:40 a.m., replacing Plan A’s Monday/Wednesday 8–9:15 a.m. studio. Your shared Monday class still starts at 10 a.m.

The tradeoff: B spreads classes across four days instead of three, and studio ends just 20 minutes before your Tuesday/Thursday noon work shifts. Both plans include Thursday lab 5:30–6:20 p.m., have 13 credits, and satisfy your requirements without class or work conflicts.

B is better if avoiding early mornings matters most; A keeps classes concentrated into fewer days. Your saved Plan A and current enrollment remain unchanged.
